description: Output schema for NETS-AI pipeline. Aligns to NETS database variables where possible.

fields.name: Company
fields.description: Business name as returned by Google Maps Places API

fields.name: Calculated_NAICS
fields.description: 6-digit NAICS code assigned by GPT-4o-mini based on hours, attributes, and reviews

fields.name: Target_NAICS
fields.description: Expected NAICS code for the search category (ground-truth target)

fields.name: Is_Target_Match
fields.description: True if Calculated_NAICS equals Target_NAICS

fields.name: Confidence
fields.description: GPT classification confidence: High or Low

fields.name: Match_Reasoning
fields.description: Brief natural-language explanation of the NAICS assignment

fields.name: Business_Status
fields.description: Operating status of the business: Active or Inactive

fields.name: Review_Count
fields.description: Number of reviews fetched (max 5 from Google Places API)

fields.name: Has_Reviews
fields.description: Whether any reviews were available: Yes or No

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: GPS latitude (WGS84)

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: GPS longitude (WGS84)

fields.name: Street_Address
fields.description: Full formatted street address

fields.name: City
fields.description: Target city name

fields.name: State
fields.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation

fields.name: Zip_Code
fields.description: ZIP code from which this place was discovered

fields.name: Operating_Hours
fields.description: Semicolon-separated weekday hours (e.g. 'Monday: 7 AM–8 PM; Tuesday: ...')

fields.name: Hard_Attributes
fields.description: Comma-separated meal/drink attributes (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Beer, Wine)

fields.name: Price_Level
fields.description: Google price level: 1 (inexpensive) to 4 (very expensive), or N/A

fields.name: Business_Website
fields.description: Business website URL if available

fields.name: Employees_Estimated
fields.description: Estimated employee count from GPT. Treat as approximate; not payroll data.

fields.name: Year_Established
fields.description: Estimated year the business opened. Treat as approximate.

fields.name: Last_Review_Date
fields.description: Date of the most recent review (YYYY-MM-DD), or N/A
